_comment: Field definitions for the SUPERVISION 'bdd' table/CSV export (site-level data, not tied to a single magnet/housing). Each entry maps a column name to {description, symbol, unit, group}. unit must be a pint-parseable string; use null for dimensionless/time columns. 'group' assigns the field to a display block in the dashboards — 'Refroidissement' matches pupitre-defs.json's own cooling-loop group name so bdd's site-level temperatures can be shown alongside a magnet's own pupitre temperature channels.
